gaps.title: Change the plan when risk grows
gaps.disclosure_location: 7D coverage_backlog,9N brief introductory/input/output sections and this review; no new learner-facing coverage screen is claimed.

editorial_review.objective: Reassess accumulated conditions, explain reduced margins and justify adaptation, stopping or changing/cancelling a plan.
editorial_review.format: Proposed unscored three-stage text decision record; initial manageable adaptation, safe-stop route check, final refusal to resume with an unfit driver.
editorial_review.review: Six criteria test carried-forward facts and combined risk, rather than a hazard list or numerical risk score. Safe alternatives may vary where supplied facts support them; the final no-continuation boundary cannot be waived by coffee, reduced speed or proximity.

gaps.title: Explain a whole journey
gaps.disclosure_location: 7D coverage_backlog,9N brief introductory/input/output sections and this review; no new learner-facing coverage screen is claimed.

editorial_review.objective: Explain a complete outward/return journey, distinguish evidence from assumptions, identify unsafe choices and propose actionable safer alternatives.
editorial_review.format: Proposed unscored five-stage journey review/reflection. Explicit geometry, crossing-distance, traffic and clear-path facts prevent hidden-fact scoring.
editorial_review.review: Six criteria cover all five stages and require both sound and unsafe choices to be explained. No-collision luck does not validate an unsafe stop/overtake; written reflection does not certify real driving competence. Accept feasible safe alternatives with supported reasoning.
editorial_review.source_scope: Original integrative teaching proposal, not an official test/court case; source dates unchanged and future authors must recheck provisions.

gaps.future_authoring_acceptance: Independent second review required by each brief before future acceptance; all rows met, equivalent safe reasoning allowed, no invented hidden facts.
